scope: Existing ordinary finite-FOV real-keyboard frames reviewed directly; no browser, no diagnostic fullbright used. Named directions are requested capture inputs, visual review follows actual pixels.

groups.finding: Original solitary sentinel rejected. Repaired source3098 joins lower broad shoulder to taller oblique primary body and adds differently oriented west-to-south L mouth; actual passage and both joint planes are visible. Other monolith remains solitary. See b07-identity-review.json for root actual four-frame independent review.
groups.originalRejection: Actual local views share blue laminated tall mass, pale cut edge, purple quiet floor and one L opening. Current proportion change is insufficient. Only sentinel is being reorganized as connected high/low shoulders with differently directed real mouths.

groups.finding: Pleated hide is a broad folded sheet route, felt has two actual concave cavities separated by a solid thick divider, pale sail has two facing sheets and a staggered through gap. Difference survives ignoring color. Eastern pleated frame mostly shows bare floor: not proof of all outside edges. Quilted now separately reviewed below: segmented leaves and low connecting surface, not a continuous pleated sheet or concave cavity.

Crystal has a multi-direction fork junction with fine linear fibres rather than a continuous rear spine enclosing slots. Rib-vault shows a separate shorter/lower rib group across a quiet connecting bed; amber shows one larger thick closed-head slot group and a low flow tail reached by an outside bypass. Visible fine layered ribs versus coarse thick resin cut faces offer a physical distinction, but rib-vault/amber share the comb grammar strongly. This is bounded local organization evidence, not whole-route fatigue approval.
nonColorDifferences: Two unequal separated rib groups with connecting quiet bed versus one thick comb with low flow tail.

rootIndependentReview.verdict: Bounded difference accepted: thick resin closed-head groove and low tail versus fine layered higher main rib group plus shorter group with open connection. Shared comb family remains a weak-neighbor risk, not alone a reason to rebuild. No whole-route fatigue approval.

groups.finding: Bleached is a high broad bank with a deep incomplete-side recess and a separate small fragment; chalk has two thick rough stepped banks with an offset walkable floor gap; satin is crossed low relief leaf surfaces with a localized raised fold; lacquer shows a low layered bank below a separate higher broken ridge. The low traversable relief versus blocking thick bank is the primary non-color difference; high/low distribution and passage orientation provide the second. The chalk gap was previously independently checked as real ground, not walking atop the projected bank.
nonColorDifferences: Crossable relief versus high blocking bank, with visibly different edge thickness.
Single broad-bank recess versus paired offset banks versus low open fan with a localized high fold; different approach and bypass paths.

groups.finding: Root has paired connected smaller courts, rib ends enclosing two distinct quiet beds; splinter has three separated inward groups connecting one larger offset court through differently directed open ends. Source fibre is shared; organization/open transfer plus group hierarchy, not hue alone, support limited distinction.

Quilted segmented tall leaf tips interrupt two crossing low connections, ember thick lobes remain peripheral to bare court, pleated uses broad connected mother folds, felt presents concave cavity + divider, satin is predominantly traversable low sheet with one local high fold. Material grammar overlap is retained; role of low surface and connected vs segmented blocking are visible non-color distinctions.

Silt visibly has coarse compacted grains and small isolated differently directed feet separated by exposed travel; tendon continuous fine fibrous stretched planes have larger heavy shoulders, sentinel one joined high/low body with two mouth directions. Foot grammar is shared. Silt third mouth was not actually walked here, so the three-body arrangement is authored/static-supported beyond the first two observed bodies.

Foam opens successive cavities toward one continuous outside channel; shell-causeway has opposing diagonally displaced cavities reached by transverse low-layer crossing. Main/secondary arcs and thick inner lips are physically visible. Medium light eater hides part of connection; real route establishes crossing but not every join surface.

limitations: Direct image comparisons are local finite-FOV material/space evidence; they do not certify full library long-session fatigue, every exterior or all seeds.
Shared six source materials and six construction profiles are explicit, not 52 unique rendering techniques.
Actual subjective audio listening remains pending; no audio heard claim.
summary: No unresolved palette-only duplicate found within recorded local scopes after sentinel repair. Amber/rib remains weakest shared comb neighbor with acknowledged bounded distinctions. This is not a claim that every pair among 52 worlds is unique in every frame.
